title: Śrī Caitanya-bhāgavata & Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta
description: Essential pastimes, vows, associates, and theological milestones from Śrī Caitanya-bhāgavata and Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta.

questions.question: On which auspicious lunar days did Lord Nityānanda and Lord Gauracandra (Caitanya Mahāprabhu) appear, according to Śrīla Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura?
options: Nityānanda on Māghī Śuklā Trayodaśī and Gauracandra on Phālgunī Paurṇamāsī
Nityānanda on Ekādaśī and Gauracandra on Dvādaśī
Nityānanda on Caitra Pūrṇimā and Gauracandra on Māgha Saptamī
Nityānanda on Janmāṣṭamī and Gauracandra on Rāma-navamī
questions.explanation: According to Śrīla Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura in Śrī Caitanya-bhāgavata, Lord Nityānanda appeared on Māghī Śuklā Trayodaśī (the 13th day of the waxing moon in Māgha) and Lord Gauracandra appeared on Phālgunī Paurṇamāsī (full-moon night in Phālguna).

questions.question: What specific vow did Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu request His mother, Śacīdevī, to accept as a gift in charity?
options: To distribute rice to all the brāhmaṇas daily
Never to eat grains on Ekādaśī
To prepare twenty varieties of spinach every afternoon
To travel to Jagannātha Purī immediately
questions.explanation: In Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu fell down at the feet of His mother Śacīdevī and asked her for one gift in charity: never to eat grains on Ekādaśī.

questions.question: How did the great devotee Śrīdhara (Kholāvecā Śrīdhara) earn his daily livelihood in Navadvīpa?
options: By weaving fine silk cloth
By selling banana leaves, stems, and flowers
By selling milk and sweetmeats
By crafting conchshell bangles
questions.explanation: Kholāvecā Śrīdhara maintained his life in Navadvīpa by selling banana trees, leaves, stems, and flowers, spending half of his daily meager profit to worship the River Ganges.
questions.reference: Śrī Caitanya-bhāgavata, Ādi-khaṇḍa / Kholāvecā Śrīdhara Caritra

questions.question: Where was Śrīla Haridāsa Ṭhākura severely whipped by the miscreant guards under the orders of the Kazi?
options: In twelve forest groves of Vṛndāvana
In twenty-two public marketplaces
In the royal court of Navadvīpa
On the bathing ghāṭas of Puri
questions.explanation: The Kazi ordered guards to beat Haridāsa Ṭhākura in twenty-two marketplaces (bāiśa bājāra) in an attempt to kill him for loudly chanting Kṛṣṇa's holy names.
questions.reference: Śrī Caitanya-bhāgavata, Ādi-khaṇḍa / Haridāsa Ṭhākura Pastimes

questions.question: Which intimate associate broke Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's sannyāsa staff (daṇḍa) into three pieces and threw it into the river?
options: Advaita Ācārya
Lord Nityānanda Prabhu
Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura
Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya
questions.explanation: While Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu visited the Kapoteśvara Śiva temple, Lord Nityānanda Prabhu broke His sannyāsa staff into three pieces at Kamalapura and threw it into the Bhārgīnadī river.
